seo.title: Our spaces — Carnot and Granvelle in Besançon
seo.description: 170 sqm across two addresses in central Besançon: 4 private offices on avenue Carnot, coworking and closed offices on rue Granvelle.

title: More than just an office!
text: A place where you feel good, with services that help your business grow. Turnkey, all-inclusive rental as a service contract.

spaces.text: Located at 11 avenue Carnot, close to Micaud park in Besançon. This human-sized business hub in the heart of the city offers 4 private offices, a meeting room and a lounge (fully fitted kitchen, toilets, shower). Fully refurbished, set around an inner courtyard, which guarantees absolute quiet for its tenants.

amenities.title: Office
amenities.text: Individual office of 9 to 12 sqm, quiet, 24/7 access.

amenities.title: Furniture
amenities.text: Modern desk, visitor chairs and storage unit.

amenities.title: Meetings
amenities.text: Shared meeting room with a video projection system.

amenities.title: Lounge
amenities.text: Fitted kitchen with coffee machine, fridge, microwave… Shower and toilets.

amenities.title: And much more!
amenities.text: Everything is included: bills, water, electricity, heating, cleaning…

spaces.text: iOiO « Granvelle » invites you to work in a coworking space on a quiet street, at 3 rue Granvelle, a sought-after spot in central Besançon, facing Granvelle park. iOiO Granvelle offers private offices or open-space desks: desk, armchair, key locker, lounge and meeting area. A cocooning place that makes work feel good.
access: In the heart of the city loop
